caption: dreamy lofi ballad with clear tender female vocal, soft rhodes piano, warm bass, gentle drums, lush pads, bright clean mix, C major, 75 BPM
lyrics:
[verse]
Soft light on the window sill
Dreams are drifting slowly still
Every star a gentle sign
You are always on my mind

[chorus]
Hold me in the quiet glow
Let the tender evening flow
Whisper like a summer stream
Safe inside this gentle dream

[verse]
Morning paints the clouds in gold
Quiet stories yet untold
Every heartbeat soft and true
I keep every moment with you

[chorus]
Hold me in the quiet glow
Let the tender evening flow
Whisper like a summer stream
Safe inside this gentle dream

[outro]
